text: The Nominating Panel - Compliance Audit Committee will recommend one alternate to City Council for appointment to the Compliance Audit Committee.

The Nominating Panel - Compliance Audit Committee recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidate to the Compliance Audit Committee as an alternate for a term of office coincident with the term of Council that takes place following the 2026 regular municipal election, such appointment to be effective only in the event that any vacancies on the Compliance Audit Committee occur: Richard Austin
